# Visual assets · 视觉素材

Illustrations, 3D, photography, mock-ups, and code-native backgrounds. Licence mistakes are the main risk in this domain: the Access column states the licence reality for each source.

46 resources, plus 3 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `python3 "$S/catalog.py" find` (`S` = `skills/design-studio/scripts`) searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Illustrations · 插画

One style per product. Widely used free sets are instantly recognisable; restyle or use sparingly.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Fluent Emoji (home: icons)](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-emoji) | Microsoft's open emoji set in four styles (3D, Color, Flat, High Contrast) as SVG and PNG; usable as friendly spot illustrations | Pick one style; fetch files by path from jsDelivr (assets/<Name>/<Style>/...) and keep them at emoji or spot-illustration sizes | A | icon-set | static | free · MIT | API `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/microsoft/fluentui-emoji@latest/assets/{Name}/{Style}/{file}.svg` |
| [unDraw](https://undraw.co) | Open-source flat illustrations recolourable to a brand hue | Set the brand colour on the site before downloading; restyle (line weight, palette, crop) so the set does not read as unDraw | A | asset-library | static | free · unDraw licence: free commercial use without attribution; no redistribution as packs, no AI training, no integrations |  |
| [Open Peeps](https://www.openpeeps.com) | Mix-and-match hand-drawn people library | Compose characters from parts | A | asset-library | static | free · CC0 |  |

| [Open Doodles](https://www.opendoodles.com) | Loose sketchy illustration set with a colour generator | For informal, friendly tone | B | asset-library | static | free · CC0 · archived |  |

| [LiblibAI (哩布哩布) (zh) (home: ai)](https://www.liblib.art) | Large Chinese community of image-generation models and style LoRAs with online generation | Use to find a style model for a consistent illustration set; check each model's licence and commercial terms individually. | B | community | js | freemium · login · Licence per model |  |

## 3D · 3D 素材

Models, materials and scenes. Check the runtime cost before embedding.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com) | Public-domain HDRIs, PBR textures and models of high quality | API available; the default for lighting and materials | S | asset-library | static | free · CC0 | API `https://api.polyhaven.com/assets?t={hdris\|textures\|models}` |
| [3dicons](https://3dicons.co) | Open-source 3D icons rendered in several angles and colours | Download the PNG render in the angle and colour you need, or open the Blender source to re-render in your palette; CC0, no credit needed | A | asset-library | static | free · CC0 |  |
| [ambientCG](https://ambientcg.com) | Public-domain PBR materials | Second source for PBR textures after Poly Haven; query the JSON API by type and keyword | A | asset-library | static | free · CC0 | API `https://ambientcg.com/api/v2/full_json?type={Material\|HDRI\|3DModel}&q={query}&limit={n}` |
| [Spline](https://spline.design) | Browser 3D design tool with states, events and web export, plus a community of remixable scenes | Remix a community scene or build a simple one; check scene weight and loading on a mid-range phone before embedding it in a hero, and export a still for reduced motion | A | tool | static | freemium · login | [Community (remixable scenes, permissions vary)](https://community.spline.design) |
| [Kenney](https://kenney.nl) | Thousands of stylistically consistent CC0 game assets: 2D sprites, 3D models, UI packs and audio | Use for playful prototypes, game UI and placeholder 3D with zero licence risk; one pack per product keeps the style coherent | A | asset-library | static | free · CC0 |  |
| [Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com) | The largest 3D model platform, with an embeddable viewer, a Downloadable filter and many Creative Commons models | Filter Downloadable, then by licence; check polygon count and texture size before web use; record the attribution string for CC BY models | A | asset-library | static | freemium · Per model (CC variants or store licence) |  |
| [D.Design (zh)](https://d.design) | Alibaba Design's platform: original 3D avatars, scenes and elements marked free for commercial use, with online rendering and AI design tools | Use the 3D library for icons, avatars and scenes in one style; confirm the licence note on each asset before shipping | A | asset-library | js | free · login |  |

## Photography and video · 摄影与视频

Treat images consistently. Never use unlicensed images found online.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com) | High-quality free photography with strong editorial, lifestyle and texture depth; the usual first search for free photos | Skip the first page of results (the most reused images) and keep one colour grade across a product; agents need the official API with a free access key | A | asset-library | static | freemium · Unsplash licence: free commercial use, no resale of unaltered photos; Unsplash+ is paid | [Developer API (free access key)](https://unsplash.com/developers) |
| [Coverr](https://coverr.co) | Stock video made for website backgrounds | Compress and provide a poster frame | A | asset-library | static | freemium · Free licence for most clips |  |
| [Mixkit](https://mixkit.co) | Free video clips, music and UI sound effects | Source for subtle interface sounds | A | asset-library | static | free · Mixkit licence per asset type |  |
| [The Met Open Access and Collection API](https://metmuseum.github.io/) | Keyless JSON API over the Metropolitan Museum's collection; objects flagged isPublicDomain come with high-resolution CC0 images | Search /search?hasImages=true&q=<q>, fetch /objects/<id>, use primaryImage only when isPublicDomain is true; stay under 80 requests per second | A | api | static | free · CC0 for public-domain objects | API `https://collectionapi.metmuseum.org/public/collection/v1/search?hasImages=true&q={query}` |
| [Wikimedia Commons (multi)](https://commons.wikimedia.org) | The largest free media repository: photos, maps, diagrams and historical images, each with its licence and author on the file page | Search, open the file page and copy the licence and attribution block; agents use the MediaWiki API (list=search, srnamespace=6 for files) | A | asset-library | static | free · Per file (CC BY, CC BY-SA, public domain...) | [Reusing content outside Wikimedia (how to attribute)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Commons:Reusing_content_outside_Wikimedia); API `https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=search&srsearch={query}&srnamespace=6&format=json` |
| [Tuchong Creative (zh)](https://stock.tuchong.com) | Licensed commercial stock images, video and audio for China; Adobe Stock's exclusive partner in mainland China | Use for commercial imagery in China-facing work and keep the licence record per asset; enforcement against unlicensed use is active | A | asset-library | static | paid · login · Commercial licence per asset |  |
| [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com) | Free photos and stock video with an API | Good for short background video | A | asset-library | blocked | free · Pexels licence: free commercial use | [API (free key)](https://www.pexels.com/api/) |
| [Openverse](https://openverse.org) | WordPress's search engine for openly licensed images and audio, with licence filters and an anonymous JSON API | Filter by commercial use and modification; agents query api.openverse.org/v1/images/?q=<q>&license_type=commercial and keep the returned attribution string | A | asset-library | blocked | free · Per item (CC licences and public domain) | [API reference](https://docs.openverse.org/api/reference/); API `https://api.openverse.org/v1/images/?q={query}&license_type=commercial` |
| [Smithsonian Open Access](https://www.si.edu/openaccess) | Millions of CC0 images and records from Smithsonian museums, archives and zoos, searchable on the site and through an API | Use for editorial, historical and natural-history imagery; agents call api.si.edu/openaccess/api/v1.0/search with an api.data.gov key (DEMO_KEY for tests) | A | asset-library | blocked | free · CC0 | API `https://api.si.edu/openaccess/api/v1.0/search?q={query}&api_key={key}` |

## Mock-ups and screenshot tools · 样机与截图工具

Clean frames usually present UI better than staged scenes.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Backgrounds, gradients, patterns and shaders · 背景、渐变与纹理

Often better recreated in code for control. Interpolate gradients perceptually and add grain against banding.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Haikei](https://haikei.app) | Generators for blobs, waves, layered peaks, blurry gradients, exported as SVG or PNG | Export SVG and tune the path in code | S | tool | static | free · Generated assets are free to use | [All generators](https://haikei.app/generators/) |
| [fffuel](https://www.fffuel.co) | Collection of SVG generators: noise, grain, organic shapes, patterns, gradients | nnnoise and gggrain for texture, ooorganize for grids; export SVG and keep the parameters in a comment so the texture can be regenerated | S | tool | static | free | [nnnoise (SVG noise texture)](https://www.fffuel.co/nnnoise/); [gggrain (grainy gradients)](https://www.fffuel.co/gggrain/) |
| [Paper Shaders](https://shaders.paper.design) | Zero-dependency shader components (mesh gradient, grain, dithering, warp) for React and vanilla JS | The cleanest way to ship a live shader background | S | library | static | free · Apache-2.0 | [Source and install (GitHub)](https://github.com/paper-design/shaders); [Mesh gradient](https://shaders.paper.design/mesh-gradient) |
| [Grainient](https://grainient.supply) | Grainy gradient backgrounds, animated gradients and shader tools | Use as art direction reference, then recreate in code for control | A | asset-library | static | freemium · Per pack; free and paid |  |
| [Hero Patterns](https://heropatterns.com) | Repeatable SVG background patterns with colour controls | Keep opacity low; credit as required | A | asset-library | static | free · CC BY 4.0 · archived |  |
| [Pattern Monster](https://pattern.monster) | Customisable SVG pattern generator | Export as CSS background or SVG | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [gradient.style](https://gradient.style) | Modern CSS gradient builder with colour-space interpolation and wide gamut | Interpolate in oklch or oklab to avoid grey dead zones | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [Josh Comeau gradient generator](https://www.joshwcomeau.com/gradient-generator/) | Generates lush multi-stop gradients via perceptual colour modes | For browsers without in-oklch interpolation | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [ShaderGradient](https://shadergradient.co) | Moving 3D gradient customiser with React, Figma and Framer outputs | Export a still as the reduced-motion fallback | A | tool | js | free · MIT |  |
